notes:
• After a season finale, Play moves on to the next season's first episode once it has aired
• When there's nothing new to watch, the show page offers Rewatch S1 E1 and says when the next episode airs, that you're caught up, or that the series is finished
• Next Up, the long-press menu, quick-play and the player's next episode all use the same check, so they never offer an episode that hasn't aired or doesn't exist
• Quick-play on a show you're caught up on opens the show page instead of restarting it
